data.description: If an Eidolon with this ability wins a bull rush check by 5 or more and pushes its target into a stone barrier, the target must make a DC %1 Reflex save or be forced into the barrier as if the target had cast meld into stone until the victim makes a successful DC %1 Fortitude save as a full-round action to exit the stone.|10+HD/2+STR
data.name: Stone Curse
